answered 503 on DatabaseError 40P01 and nothing tried them again. One large GeoTIFF and the medium model
were never kept; one PDF was kept with exact bytes but never taken in.
Chain: the dispatcher event loop stalled 8.4 s (about 8.5 to 16.9 s after Add) holding seven jobs; lock
waits of 6.4 to 7.8 s on case rows and an advisory lock were sampled; 11 deadlocks fired at 17.9 to 20.2 s,
each a cycle of a case row lock (FOR SHARE, KEY SHARE or UPDATE) against INSERT INTO usp_outbox_streams.
The same window failed the small model's native read and its layer keep (NATIVE_DERIVATIVE_UNAVAILABLE, no
layer, not on the map), the small GeoTIFF's second raster window (1 of 2 parts) and fenced CSV attempts.
Needs a diagnosis task: how case row locks and outbox stream inserts can cycle, why the dispatcher loop
blocks 8.4 s with jobs open, and whether batch upload requests and the layer keep should retry on 40P01.
Better: no frame over 100 ms from the Add press; the kept large GeoTIFF drew at 114.3 s (run 6: 169.2 s).
Act 1 passes again: cited card and 8/8 journey checks. No layer-copy slot wait was seen in run 7.
